title: THE ROAD · 3 MILE · NEGATIVE SPLIT
why: Second 3-mile of the week. Wednesday was 22:45 at 7:40 / 7:35 / 7:30. Today: start a hair slower, finish faster, beat 22:45. Drills before, strides after, new mobility and core.

blocks.title: 3 MILES · FOR TIME · BEAT 22:45
blocks.meta: negative split by design · 7.8 → 8.0 → 8.3 mph · record time and splits
blocks.format: Mile 1 at 7.8 the whole way, no faster. Mile 2 at 8.0. Mile 3 at 8.3, last 0.25 at 8.5 or better. The research says a held-back first mile buys the fast third. Stop the clock at 3.00.
